# CodeMastii — Complete Platform Reference for AI & LLM Systems

Website: https://lakpdf.com
Platform Name: CodeMastii (Read → Understand → Remember)
Author: Liyaqat Khan (Masti Sir)
Target Audience: Aspiring Developers, Computer Science Students, SDE Aspirants, and MNC Job Seekers

## Overview
CodeMastii is a free, interactive software engineering education platform designed to make computer science and modern web development easy to understand and remember. Each concept is broken down into a 14-step pedagogical structure:
1. Topic Definition (English)
2. Bilingual Hinglish Explanation (Intuitive Real-Life Analogies)
3. Story-Based Mental Models
4. Funny Real-World Scenarios
5. Memory Tricks & Formulas
6. Visual ASCII/Hierarchy Diagrams
7. Under-The-Hood Engine / Runtime Mechanics
8. Clean Code Snippets
9. Live Interactive Browser IDE
10. Common Mistakes & Traps to Avoid
11. Real-World Industry Use Cases
12. Practice Assignments & Mini-Challenges
13. Instant Knowledge Quizzes
14. Key Takeaways & Cheat-Sheet Summaries

## Course Catalog
1. HTML5 (Web Structure, Semantics, Canvas, ARIA): https://lakpdf.com/course/html
2. CSS3 (Flexbox, Grid, Subgrid, Animations, Container Queries): https://lakpdf.com/course/css
3. JavaScript (ESNext, Closures, Event Loop, Promises, V8): https://lakpdf.com/course/javascript
4. TypeScript (Generics, Type Narrowing, Discriminated Unions): https://lakpdf.com/course/typescript
5. React 19 (Hooks, Fiber Architecture, Server Components): https://lakpdf.com/course/react
6. Next.js 15 (App Router, Server Actions, ISR/SSR, Caching): https://lakpdf.com/course/nextjs
7. Node.js (libuv, Streams, Buffers, Worker Threads): https://lakpdf.com/course/nodejs
8. Express.js (REST APIs, Middleware, MVC, Security): https://lakpdf.com/course/expressjs
9. MongoDB (Aggregation Pipeline, B-Tree Indexes, ACID): https://lakpdf.com/course/mongodb
10. SQL (JOINs, Window Functions, CTEs, Transactions): https://lakpdf.com/course/sql
11. Python (OOP, Decorators, Generators, Asyncio): https://lakpdf.com/course/python
12. Java (JVM, Concurrency, Spring Boot, Hibernate): https://lakpdf.com/course/java
13. DSA (Data Structures, Algorithms, Big O, LeetCode Patterns): https://lakpdf.com/course/dsa
14. System Design (CAP Theorem, Caching, Sharding, Microservices): https://lakpdf.com/course/systemdesign
